Dusknoir

Ghost

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Dusknoir is a Ghost-type Gripper Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 2.2 m tall and weighs 106.6 kg. It evolves from Dusclops. Its highest base stat is Defense (135), with a base stat total of 525.
